We are a deep-tech company that creates and produces internationally awarded smart glasses. Our headquarters is in Vienna, where we develop and manufacture both the hardware and the software of the smart glasses.

From research & development, engineering, production to marketing and sales - we offer everything from a single source under one roof. This will give you exciting insights into other departments of the company. Although we have our roots in Austria, we are "born global" and work with customers and sales partners all over the world.

Making Future Reality together - are you in? 1 Assembly Technician (m/f/x) - The Craft Hand Vienna 1010, fulltime

We build award-winning smart glasses in Vienna: hardware, firmware, software, all under one roof. Behind every device that ships is precise, careful, hands-on work, and that's exactly what this role is about. You'll be part of the team that turns components into finished products, working closely with engineers, quality assurance, and production to keep things moving and the standards high.

This is a role where your hands-on skill and attention to detail make a visible difference every single day.

Tasks

What You'll Be Doing

 * Hands-on assembly of components and devices across different stages of the production process

 * Material preparation, pre-assembly, cleaning, packaging, and warehouse support

 * Use hand and power tools to assemble products with precision and care

 * Inspect components and assemblies to ensure quality standards are met

 * Document and report any discrepancies in the assembly process

 * Collaborate with team members to meet production deadlines

 * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives on the production floor

Requirements

What You Bring to the Team

 * Completed technical apprenticeship, ongoing or recently completed HTL, or relevant studies

 * Solid technical understanding and careful handling of small components and electronics

 * Manual dexterity and good hand-eye coordination

 * Familiarity with assembly processes, tools, and techniques

 * Attention to detail and a practical problem-solving mindset

 * Flexibility to support a wide range of tasks in production

 * Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies

 * Good communication skills in German and/or English

Benefits

What's extra?

 * Salary: €2.400 - €4.000 gross/month depending on experience

 * Yearly public transport card (Vienna)

 * "Inspire Days" - time to learn and recharge

 * A front-row seat to how a deep-tech hardware product gets built, from PCB to shipped device

 * International team where your impact is visible every day

Ready to be part of the team that makes smart glasses real?

We can't wait to meet you.

Making Future Reality - let's assemble it together.

Send us your application and let's take off together!

As an attractive employer, Erste Group offers interesting career opportunities in an international environment.

Department Description

The Team Corporate Underwriting & Analysis is part of the Corporate Risk Management Division of Erste Group Bank AG (Holding) and consists of a fair mix of underwriters and business analysts. It deals with corporate risk matters of Austrian and International Corporate Clients with strong focus on CEE.

The core competence consists in analyzing, recommending and/or taking credit decisions for corporate customers. In selected cases underwriters are supported by the business analysts with in-depth analysis, peer group comparisons and forecasting. 1 Corporate Risk Manager - Renewable Energy (all genders)  * Location:Wien

 * Working hours:Full-time

 * Occupational Area:Risikomanagement

 * Company:Erste Group Bank AG

Your Tasks

 * Assessment of the credit worthiness of large national and international corporates in Austria and CEE, including the forward looking assessment of the respective business model, repayment capability and liquidity (thereby dealing with loans, export-, trading-, project- and leveraged acquisition financings)

 * Deciding on loan applications either within your discretionary approval authority or preparing a clear recommendation to the final decision maker

 * Responsible for a dedicated portfolio of corporate client groups with focus on energy (renewable energy projects) as well as consumer goods

 * Defining of risk strategies on clients and the covered industry

 * Participating in client meetings

 * Cooperation with different departments and CEE subsidiaries within Erste Group

 * Contribution to various Group and Department projects alongside the credit process

Your Background

 * Graduate in business administration or law

 * Solid experience in Corporate Banking (Account Manager/Risk Manager/Credit Analysis/Corporate Finance) with min. 3 years of activity in these areas

 * Proven track record in risk management within the renewable energy industry

 * Familiar with lending products and legal basics

 * Strong analytical, writing and presentation skills in German and English to present complex issues concisely

 * Flexibility and resilience to perform in a fast-paced environment

 * Readiness to cooperate with colleagues of other departments/ CEE subsidiaries in a multi-cultural environment

 * Willingness to travel (occasionally)

 * Open-minded & result- and target-oriented

 * Very good language skills in German and English are a pre-condition

Our Offer

 * We take care of your personal wellbeing, career development, and we actively support your educational needs

 * Discover and enjoy the benefits of Erste Group

 * The minimum wage for this full-time position in accordance with the collective agreement with complete fulfillment of the functional profile is EUR 51.336,-- gross per year. But this is just a formality - we would be happy to talk about your actual salary in person!

 * We offer our employees the opportunity to divide their hours between working from home and at the office.

 * We consider the diversity of our employees as key to innovation and success. As employer we are proud to offer everyone equal chances, irrespective of age, skin colour, religious belief, gender, sexual orientation or origin.

jobs.occupation: Junior Scientists (f/m/d) for 6G Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC) - JOB ID: 269373
jobs.description: 1 Junior Scientists (f/m/d) for 6G Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC) - JOB ID: 269373  * You will develop and validate numerical signal processing algorithms for mobile 5G/6G ISAC scenarios using simulations and measurements from an SDR testbed combining RF, fiber optic, and quantum sensing. * Depending on your background, you will conduct algorithm research and contribute to real-time experiments using SDR hardware and reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS). * Together with experienced colleagues, you will engage in establishing a unique 6G distributed MIMO sensing testbed based on SDR technology using open-source tools such as GNU Radio, RFNoC and LabVIEW for real-time FPGA algorithm design operating from 0.4 - 20 GHz. * You will learn how to evaluate the results and prepare them for further studies. * You will publish your research results in international journals and present them at conferences. * You will accumulate experience in a research field, that has an enormous range of applications from construction, logistics, aviation and railways to agriculture, robotics and defense. * You will gain experience in a group of international scientists and build up your professional network within European wide research projects.Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner: * Completed technical studies (at least MSc.) related to Telecommunications, Computer Science or Electrical Engineering * First experience in at least one of the following areas: (i) multi-static MIMO UAV sensing, (ii) quantum sensing with NV centers and Rydberg cells, (iii) multimodal sensing with fiber optic and distributed RF sensors, or (iv) ISAC using reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS) and two-way ranging. Candidates should indicate in their cover letter how their background and interests align with one of these profiles (i-iv) and provide evidence of relevant expertise. Applications not addressing this point may not be considered. * Hands-on experience in radio frequency (RF) lab experimentation and printed circuit board design for the profiles listed above. * Excellent knowledge in the field of signal processing, RF propagation modeling, AI/ML and numerical simulation software development (MATLAB or Python) * Sound knowledge of electromagnetic field simulation tools, antenna design, and real-time FPGA programming. * Interest in reading and writing scientific publications and enjoyment of solving application-oriented questions from industry * High level of commitment and ability to work in a team * German and English skills commensurate with the role What to expect:  * The minimum gross annual salary on a full-time basis (38,5 h / week) according to the collective agreement is EUR 56.784,--. The actual salary will be determined individually, based on your qualifications and experience. * Our employee benefits include meal allowances, healthcare benefits, pension support, family benefits, additional days off, vouchers, sports and cultural activities, and flexible working models including up to 50% home office.We also support conference participation, networking, and individual training and career development opportunities. We encourage our Junior Scientist (f/m/d) to pursue a doctoral degree at TU Wien. Through the AIT-PhD programme with renowned universities, you will have the opportunity to conduct your PhD thesis in collaboration with AIT experts and national and international research partners. At AIT, we foster an inclusive and family-friendly work environment that promotes equal opportunities and values diversity across all levels of the organisation. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants. Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates (transcript of records), as well as a proof of identity....

jobs.occupation: Master Thesis "Differentiable Ray Tracing for Radio Propagation Modeling" - JOB ID: 269596
jobs.description: 1 Master Thesis "Differentiable Ray Tracing for Radio Propagation Modeling" - JOB ID: 269596  * Differentiable ray-tracing frameworks such as Sionna RT have become powerful tools for wireless channel modeling. This master's thesis advances differentiable ray tracing for realistic large-scale radio propagation, either by integrating atmospheric refraction models or by learning electromagnetic environment properties directly from channel measurements. * Under the guidance of our team, you will implement and evaluate atmospheric refraction models in the differentiable ray-tracing framework Sionna RT. * You will implement and evaluate differentiable algorithms for estimating electromagnetic material properties from real-world channel measurements. * You will learn how to develop and validate simulation workflows for large-scale radio propagation, combining physics-based propagation models with discrete ray tracing, low-complexity ray-shooting, and gradient-based optimisation techniques. * You will gain hands-on experience with modern wireless communication simulation frameworks, electromagnetic wave propagation, physics-based and inverse modeling, and AI-enabled optimisation methods. * You will work closely with researchers in wireless communications and contribute to the development of next-generation ray-tracing methods for realistic large-scale propagation prediction.Your qualifications: * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field. * First experience in at least one of the following areas: (i) atmospheric refraction modelling for ray tracing or (ii) learning environment properties using differentiable ray tracing. Candidates should explain in their cover letter how their background matches one of these areas and demonstrate relevant expertise. * You have solid programming skills in Python; experience with object-oriented software development is an advantage. * You have a basic understanding of electromagnetics, wave propagation, wireless communications, or computer graphics. * Knowledge of ray tracing, geometric optics, optimisation methods, or machine learning is beneficial but not required. * Experience with scientific computing frameworks (e.g., NumPy, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Sionna) is a plus. * You enjoy developing algorithms and solving challenging scientific and engineering problems. * You are able to work independently while collaborating effectively in an interdisciplinary research team. * English language skills commensurate with the roleWhat to expect: * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months * Start date: as soon as possible - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week. * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results. * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).  At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants. jobs.description: 1 Master Thesis "Bi-Static Sensing of UAVs" - JOB ID: 269595  * Reliable detection and localisation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is becoming increasingly important for future civilian and commercial applications. This master's thesis focuses on the development and experimental validation of antenna arrays for bi-static sensing of UAVs using software-defined radio technology. * Under the guidance of our team, you will design, build, and characterise circularly polarised patch antennas for different array geometries for UAV sensing applications. * You will integrate the antenna arrays into an SDR-based testbed and perform experimental validation. * You will support us in developing simulation models for bi-static multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) sensing and realise a real-time measurement setup that can estimate azimuth, elevation and range. * You will gain hands-on experience with antenna design, beamforming, direction-of-arrival estimation, and software-defined radio systems. * You will learn how to validate the sensing algorithms using a state-of-the-art motion capture system. * You will work closely with researchers in wireless sensing and contribute to the development of next-generation UAV detection and localisation technologies.Your qualifications: * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field. * First experience (e.g. gained through university / student research projects, laboratory work, internships or similar activities) in at least one of the following areas: (i) Antenna array design and validation measurements or (ii) micro-Doppler-based bi-static sensing methods. In the cover letter, the candidate shall describe how their CV and personal interests for future development match at least one of the above profiles (explicitly referring to (i) or (ii)) and substantiate their claimed expertise. Please note that applications that do not address this point may not be considered further. * You have a basic understanding of antennas, electromagnetics, and wireless communications. * Experience with RF measurement equipment, software-defined radio (SDR), or antenna simulation tools (e.g., CST, HFSS, or FEKO) is advantageous. * Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ for signal processing, beamforming, or bi-static sensing applications is beneficial. * You enjoy developing hardware prototypes and numerical algorithms, as well as performing experimental validation. * English language skills commensurate with the roleWhat to expect: * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months * Start date: as soon as possible - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week. * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results. * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).
